Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 21  
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to definitively confirm the exact headquarters city of the Sazerac Company, leading to ambiguity between Metairie, Louisiana, and Louisville, Kentucky.
